items.title: 3 Financial Stocks Tied To Money Market Demand While Rates Stay High
items.summary: Inflation is still running hotter than the Fed wants, policy rates are parked in the 3.75% to 4% range, and cash is no longer just a parking lot; it is part of the story. That mix keeps pressure on long-duration assets while throwing fresh attention on short-duration cash and money market providers that sit close to the policy fire. This article unpacks three stocks exposed to these inflation and rate signals, explaining where the current backdrop may help and where it could hurt. The stocks...
